data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger, a public-stage Defense & Security company founded by Chun Lin Lai, has raised $22M+ as of 2025. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Evolv Technology, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The Defense & Security sector contains 23 same-sector peers overall, though the narrow peer set—filtered by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier—proved insufficient to support a reliable peer-median multiple approach.

The peer-median methodology is not applicable to this valuation. The narrow peer filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-tier companies) yielded fewer than three comparable datapoints, falling below the threshold for statistical reliability. Using an all-sector median would introduce material distortion given Thunder Tiger's specific market position and stage. Accordingly, this peer set serves primarily as directional context rather than as the basis for quantitative multiple triangulation.

A complete valuation conclusion cannot be drawn from the available data. Further analysis would require either: expanded comparable financials from the identified public and private peer set; revenue or EBITDA multiples for subset peers; or primary financial metrics (revenue run-rate, burn rate, growth trajectory) for Thunder Tiger itself. The current dataset establishes the relevant peer universe but does not support a narrowed valuation range.
